description: Row edited directly in the database (superuser) breaks the hash chain

input.statement: UPDATE audit_log SET parameters = '{}' WHERE id = (SELECT min(id) + 1 FROM audit_log)

unsafe_if: the hash-chain check reports the chain as intact after a direct edit

attack.statement: UPDATE audit_log SET parameters = '{}' WHERE id = (SELECT min(id) + 1 FROM audit_log)
attack.undo: UPDATE audit_log SET parameters = '{"payment_request_id": 1}' WHERE id = (SELECT min(id) + 1 FROM audit_log)
